$comment: Self-derived finetype drift contract for bls/soc_2018, checked by the in-engine finetype_validate@1 gate (the model-free `ft_validate` DuckDB table macro). ft_validate MELTS every column to VARCHAR, so this contract uses ONLY the string-surviving JSON-Schema keywords. ENFORCED: the `pattern` NN-NNNN on code, code_display, parent_code and the three ancestor codes, the shape soc_2018.overrides.json publishes; the closed `enum` domains on level and text_source; the release pattern; and `minLength`/`maxLength` envelopes on the text. NOT ENFORCED, by design: numeric ranges and booleans (a numeric `type` BACKFIRES to 100% reject once melted to VARCHAR); NULLs (invisible to ft_validate); and object-level `required` (documentation only). Free-text fields carry LOOSE length envelopes with headroom. Derived from build/stage/soc_2018.parquet on BLS's files of 2026-11-03: a pass-through on today's rows, a fail-closed tripwire for future drift (a code that has lost its hyphen, a new level name, an unparsed release).
title: bls/soc_2018
